A reliable Chinese leaker with a solid track record has posted several images online claiming to be circuit diagrams of the next-generation iPhone 18 Pro models.

The images suggest that the next-generation A20 Pro chip may feature 7 GPU cores, one more than its predecessor, and adopt a faster memory interface……

The images posted by Weibo user "炸白米飯" are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather schematic diagrams showing the chip's position on the underlying circuit board. Based on this, the leaker inferred the new chip's performance and architecture, arriving at two main conclusions and discussing possible areas of improvement.

Firstly, the circuit diagram shows six CPU cores, configured the same as last year's model: two high-performance cores plus four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to be equipped with larger cache memory.

From the limited information provided by the soldering pad schematics, it is difficult to deduce the exact number of GPU cores — six, seven, or eight are all possible. Nevertheless, the leaker ultimately concluded that seven cores is the most likely possibility.

Fixed Focus Digital previously pointed out that the A20 Pro chip's performance will improve by 18% over its predecessor, while power efficiency will see a 30% improvement.

9to5Mac's take

The Weibo account does have a degree of credibility, but this method of indirect inference has a certain "dark magic" quality to it. Although the conclusions sound reasonable, they should not be regarded as confirmed information, but rather as educated speculation.
